com.android.hdms.scanner

类 ScanManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.android.hdms.base.DeviceBaseManager
      • com.android.hdms.scanner.ScanManager

  • public class ScanManager
extends DeviceBaseManager
    This class provides access to the system scanner decode services.

    To decode bar codes with this class, use the following steps:

    1. Obtain an instance of ScanManager object with: ScanManager scan = (ScanManager) HDMSManager.getInstance().getModuleManager(HDMSManager.MODULE_TYPE.SCANNER);
    2. Call open() to power on the bar code reader(The default is enabled unless the scanner has been turned off.).
    3. If necessary, get the current settings with getParameterInt(String, int defvalue).
    4. If necessary, modify the returned ScannerConstant.ParamKey object value and call setParameterInt(String, int) or setParameterString(String, String) .
      Example:
      public void getDecodeMode() {
         int mode = scan.getParameterInt(ScannerConstant.ParamKey.DECODE_OUTPUT_MODE, ScannerConstant.DecodeMode.FOCUS);
      }
      public void setDecodeMode() {
         int ret = scan.setDecodeMode(ScannerConstant.DecodeMode.BROADCAST);
      }
    5. If necessary, set the current broadcast intent settings.

      Intent mode allows the captured data to be sent as an implicit Intent. Application interested in the scan data should register default action as BROADCAST_BARCODE_ACTION broadcast receiver.

      public void setDecodingIntent() {
      //Intent action - specifies the action to handle the intent.
         scan.setParameterString(ScannerConstant.ParamKey.BROADCAST_INTENT_ACTION_NAME,"broadcast_barcode_data_action");
      //Intent extra - specifies the action to handle the intent.Acquired barcode characters
         scan.setParameterString(ScannerConstant.ParamKey.BROADCAST_INTENT_EXTRA_NAME,"dataString");
      }
    6. To begin a decode session, call startDecode(). if the configured ScannerConstant.ParamKey.DECODE_OUTPUT_MODE is ScannerConstant.DecodeMode.BROADCAST. Your registered broadcast receiver will be called when a successful decode occurs.
      In the onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) method, get the information as follow:
      String dataStr=intent.getStringExtra(BROADCAST_BARCODE_EXTRA_DATA);
      byte[] dataArray=intent.getByteArrayExtra(BROADCAST_BARCODE_EXTRA_BYTES);
      int length=intent.getIntExtra(BROADCAST_BARCODE_EXTRA_LENGTH,0);
      Symbology type id define from SymbologyId
      byte type=intent.getByteExtra(BROADCAST_BARCODE_EXTRA_TYPE,(byte)0);
      byte[] aim=intent.getByteExtra("aimCodeId");
      String symName=intent.getStringExtra("scandata_symbology");

      The information are barcode data, length of barcode data, and barcode type (symbology).

    7. Call stopDecode() to end the decode session.
    8. Call close() ()} to power off the barcode reader(Do not turn off unless absolutely necessary.).
